title: lollipops with a secret
description: Hello everyone, I present to you my mod for making 7 types of lollipops from easy to complex using special equipment.
body: Hello, dear citizens! Welcome to my mod. Today you've visited the lollipop crafting mod for Minecraft. This mod will introduce you to seven types of lollipops, as well as crafting and ingredients. The mod features 6 types of kitchen tables: furnace, mixer, filter, bottler, freezer, crusher. There are also 7 types of lollipops: metamin, crystal blue, kalaxian crystal, blesk, kronol, melanj, mdma. I apologize for not being able to add crafting to jei, but if you can help, I'd be very happy.
